description.value: Artigiano is a pioneering Vancouver specialty coffee chain with over 25 years in BC's coffee culture, now operating 25 locations across BC and Alberta. The Davie Street location is one of the brand's Cafe Bar outposts, offering locally roasted 100% Arabica espresso drinks alongside cocktails, fresh sourdough pizzas, and light Italian bites in the evenings. The brand is known for internationally award-winning barista craft and house-made baked goods sourced from organic and seasonal ingredients.
